# Talentvarya

> Talentvarya is a hiring platform in India. It connects job seekers with checked employers and gives companies a tool called HireStream to manage hiring.

## What Talentvarya offers

- Free job search and applications for candidates, with no placement fees ever charged to a candidate.
- Employer checks before a company can post an opening (business and identity verification).
- HireStream: an applicant tracking tool for employers to post roles, review candidates, and run interviews.
- A pay-after-joining pricing model for employers, where fees apply only after a hire joins and completes a trial period.
- Support for common Indian job categories, including software engineering, product, design, data, DevOps, human resources, administration, and sales.

## Key facts

- No recruiter is allowed to charge a candidate for an application, interview, or offer letter on Talentvarya.
- Employers are checked using company registration and identity verification before their jobs can go live.
- The platform is aimed at the Indian job market.
